headline: High Energy Prices Expected to Drive UK North Sea Oil and Gas Consolidation
summary: Analysts and bankers expect high oil and gas prices alongside tax considerations to trigger a new wave of mergers and acquisitions in the UK North Sea sector.
why: The UK North Sea is a major offshore energy producing region where commodity prices and tax policies heavily influence corporate strategy and asset transactions.

impacts.name: UK Oil & Gas Sector
impacts.why: Elevated energy prices and tax rules are expected to spur consolidation among UK offshore producers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
